summary: Autonomix Medical filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $1.35 million of common stock through Ladenburg Thalmann under an existing sales agreement dated February 28, 2025. The filing updates the offering size and discloses a July 30, 2026 closing price of $3.59 per share. The company will pay Ladenburg 3.0% of gross proceeds as compensation. Sales may be made at market prices under Rule 415(a)(4), with no escrow arrangement. The offering is subject to the Form S-3 I.B.6 public-float limitation; during the prior 12 months, $1,399,990 had been sold under that provision. This is a routine financing event, not a special situation.
